description: This file contains functions to start and stop polling for different application states such as nodes, logs, and debugging, by setting up or clearing interval timers that invoke external controller functions periodically.

methods.name: export function startNodesPolling(host: PollingHost) { startNodesPolling
methods.description: Starts polling for nodes at regular 5-second intervals unless already polling.

methods.name: export function stopNodesPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopNodesPolling
methods.description: Stops polling for nodes by clearing the interval.

methods.name: export function startLogsPolling(host: PollingHost) { startLogsPolling
methods.description: Starts polling for logs every 2 seconds if the current tab is 'logs'.

methods.name: export function stopLogsPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopLogsPolling
methods.description: Stops polling for logs by clearing the interval.

methods.name: export function startDebugPolling(host: PollingHost) { startDebugPolling
methods.description: Starts polling for debug information every 3 seconds if the current tab is 'debug'.

methods.name: export function stopDebugPolling(host: PollingHost) { stopDebugPolling
methods.description: Stops polling for debug information by clearing the interval.
